result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you') has very low contrast between the light green background and the white text, making it difficult to read, especially the subtitle text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10'.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast ratio between the text and background by using a darker green background or darker text color to meet WCAG AA accessibility standards (minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text).
